scope: Simulated single same-goal outbound selection followed by the original neutral G_perf continuation.

roles.shelf_01_screen: Designated later replication, previously seen formal shelf placement used for diagnosis

primary_metric: Weighted net change in independent shelf samples represented by real native RGB-D fusion meshes, using the verified common cold start in each placement.

stage_one.candidate_bank: Freeze D, original S and at least two geometry-only distinct legal alternatives whose outbound action counts match or nearly match incumbents.
stage_one.already_seen: All three placements are development or diagnosis. Reused ancestry and scope are recorded. A repeated pair of policies in one placement is one placement, not an independent replicate.
stage_one.intervention: One registered legal route at the exact archived fork bound to native target, observed prefix, budget, outbound states/actions and return. After arrival or native guard cancel, use native neutral G global and original weighted G local decisions to native terminal, with no further intervention.
stage_one.reuse: Exact full archived trajectories may be shared if the scenario, cold and fork input, actions, oriented target, return certificate and continuation are equivalent. The old short-witness trajectory serves to verify the common route prefix through its outbound outcome. It cannot substitute for a closed-loop checkpoint.
stage_one.gate: Run the full frozen development schedule. Then at actual task action 96 count how many distinct placements have a verified D and a verified alternative above the frozen tolerance in the same matched candidate bank. At least two positives enter stage II. Zero positives or one with no replication ends the study at stage I. An isolated action-16 or terminal win does not count toward this gate. Preserve native stops and missing checkpoints.
stage_one.guard_states: Record route cancellation independently of later return and task termination; include all prespecified candidates and both clocks without substituting a terminal value for a missing fixed clock.

stage_two.scope: Only after a stage I pass. Freeze a single causal-time visibility score. Discount the first effective view of each candidate surface area using its paid action and the remaining horizon, and preserve measured-history and prior-look deduplication. Keep native global, sensor, mapper, candidate admission, reserved return, unknown coverage term and action cost.
stage_two.prediction: Predict during the selected outbound segment only, with no imputed view gains after its end. Calculate at the observed fork only. Held-out evaluator geometry remains offline.
stage_two.gate: Use closed-loop measured action 96, not reduction in score error alone. Stop if new choices remain equal to D throughout or changed selections do not deliver an observed advantage over D at action 96. No post-hoc sweep of hidden-area weights.

formal.activation: Only after development and score pass
formal.design: Freeze new room and shelf pairs, poses, seeds, legal picker and execution order before outcomes. Share candidate admission and one intervention across all arms. Preserve all arms and parents through their original neutral continuation; exact same executed route identities may share an execution from the same fork.
formal.primary_comparison: screen time_class - D at task action 96
formal.prior_comparison: time_class - time_neutral with shared timed mechanism
formal.report: Report equal-parent observed contrasts, ordered rows, denominators, means, medians, wins/ties/losses, missingness, retention of action-96 exclusivity at actual return, C_free/F1/J, distance and return.
